opportunities.title: Genes & Development Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 for host laboratory expenses, and a Carer’s Award if needed.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students in their second or third year of a degree, excluding first and final years. Both the student and the research group leader must be members of The Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports undergraduate students to gain experience in genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday.
